rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something presented in the form of an allegory.

example.english: This animated series uses an allegorical style to talk about environmental protection.
example.traditional: 呢套動畫用寓言式手法講環保。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 dung6 waa2 jung6 jyu6 jin4 sik1 sau2 faat3 gong2 waan4 bou2

rows.note: Use this more formal term when discussing the allegorical quality or significance of a story, image, or work.

example.english: Scholars place particular importance on the allegorical significance of this painting.
example.traditional: 學者特別重視呢幅畫嘅寓意性。
example.jyutping: hok6 ze2 dak6 bit6 zung6 si6 ne1 fuk1 waa6 ge3 jyu6 ji3 sing3
